fixedOriginalSplitReadCase: Constant bootstrap pins, plan, assets and template use readPinnedJson.
Source/destination reports use one buffer; index is immediately tied to external preparation returned SHA.
Initial and private capsule paths already hash and parse one buffer.

newIntegrationFinding.reason: Dynamic expected hashes can be undefined when a hash field is missing. readPinnedJson intentionally treats undefined as the optional no-pin mode, so these call sites silently lose mandatory authentication.
cases: index.captures[owner] exists but has no sha256.
newIntegrationFinding.safeCorrection: Validate mandatory expected SHA at each pinned call, or use a required-pin wrapper; reserve no-pin calls for explicit index/preparation trust boundary.

remainingHashParsePairs: No other meaningful hash-then-independent-parse pair found among the reviewed pinned JSON calls. Unpinned external audit/copy/key proof reports remain external trusted inputs, not cryptographic authorities.

cmakeSourceGuard.review: Independent fixed baseline/current/insertion SHA pins, exact unique approved test-target block, and exact remainder equality to baseline. No broad deletion/fallback accepted.
